sentences.en: Thus, internationalization has become a fashionable slogan for the Japanese.
sentences.zh: 因此，国际化成为了日本的一句流行口号。

sentences.en: The slogan for the anti-extremism day was "colourful not brown".
sentences.zh: 反极端主义日的口号是‘多彩而非单一’。

sentences.en: We need a campaign slogan that'll really energize the base.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一个竞选口号来真正激发基层的热情。
